title: hevea benthamiana f. subglabrifolia
intro: Hevea benthamiana f. subglabrifolia, commonly known as the Amazonian rubber tree, is a plant species within the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a small tree native to the Amazon rainforest, known for its latex production. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The bioactive constituents of Hevea benthamiana f. subglabrifolia include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
